trigger_cases.prompt: I want to submit a pull request to an open source library on GitHub.
How should I structure this commit message using Conventional Commits?
Help me write a respectful code review comment for an external contributor.
How do I rebase my fork against upstream main before opening a PR?
A contributor is violating our code of conduct; how do we address this professionally?
Write a quarterly performance review for my direct report.
Configure an AWS S3 bucket lifecycle policy with Terraform.
Design a checkout conversion rate experiment for our private e-commerce app.

binary_cases.prompt: Format a commit message for adding a rate limiter to the auth API that breaks backwards compatibility.
binary_cases.pass_rule: The commit uses Conventional Commits syntax with breaking change indicator or footer, imperative verb, and lowercase description.
binary_cases.pass_fixture:
feat(auth)!: add token bucket rate limiter to login endpoint

BREAKING CHANGE: unauthenticated requests now return 429 after 5 attempts.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Added rate limiter to auth API so users cannot spam requests.

binary_cases.prompt: Write a code review comment for an open source PR where the author missed handling null on input parameters.
binary_cases.pass_rule: The review comment critiques the code rather than the author, explains the concrete failure mode, and proposes a direct fix without personal blame.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Handling null here prevents a crash when the input payload is empty. Can we add a guard clause at line 14?
binary_cases.fail_fixture: You forgot to handle null here again. You should know better.

binary_cases.prompt: Show the commands to sync a local fork with upstream and rebase before pushing a PR.
binary_cases.pass_rule: The command sequence fetches upstream, rebases on upstream/main, and pushes to origin.
binary_cases.pass_fixture:
Run:
git fetch upstream
git rebase upstream/main
git push -u origin feature-branch
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Just run git push upstream main directly.
